content.comment_body: Hello, I need assistance with a connection problem. I'm trying to link my PC to a [company_name] [product_name] [article_no] device after writing my first program for it. I purchased the corresponding [product_name] software, which included a green Ethernet cable. I've connected this cable between my laptop and the [product_name], but when I attempt to transfer my program, I receive a message saying: "IP Address of your PC and the target [product_name] are not in the same subnet. The application will attempt to add a local IP Address, do you want to continue?" I'm unsure how to proceed to establish communication and upload my program. Any guidance would be appreciated. Thank you, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user is experiencing difficulty connecting their PC to a [product_name] module, receiving a warning about subnet mismatch. The process for connectivity and understanding network-related prompts is unclear for new users, resulting in confusion and halted progress.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to connect their laptop to the [product_name] device easily, without needing to understand networking configurations or make manual adjustments.
